findingDetails.title: Pre-existing untracked deletions disappear from the baseline diff
findingDetails.evidence: The detector builds a map from the pre-dispatch paths but iterates only current status entries, so a baseline-only untracked path deleted before sampling is never considered.
findingDetails.recommendation: Compare the union of baseline and current out-of-scope paths; emit a deletion violation and retain baseline bytes when a baseline path is missing after dispatch.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Tracked deletions remain visible through git status, but that does not cover a deleted untracked baseline path.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The defect is in the scoped detector used by enforceWriteContainment and is directly exercised by the packet's baseline contract.

findingDetails.title: Failed or incomplete lanes skip containment entirely
findingDetails.evidence: Missing-artifact, stop-policy, and salvage branches throw before the containment call at line 3435.
findingDetails.recommendation: Run containment from a failure-safe finally/post-exit path before rethrowing the lane failure, preserving the original outcome and recording both results.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Successful lanes reach containment, but the earlier failure branches demonstrably throw first.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The runner's terminal gate ordering governs every CLI lineage in the target packet.
